proposal.brief_basis: The home page provides the visible “Open Dashboard” link; the dashboard must be reviewed before opening the workflow form.
The dashboard has been reviewed and the visible next step is the Open Form link.

The dashboard chart shows a large decline from about 23.9 in 2005 to about 10.1 in 2014, but no public routing threshold or active applicable rule defines what magnitude qualifies as “large enough” for substantial-change follow-up versus ordinary variation.
